scientific_integrity: The normalized Reuleaux-domain nearest-generator distance law is proved by exact angular partition and elementary integration; finite numerical diagnostics are corroboration, not proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly area-sampled points in the classical width-one three-disk Reuleaux triangle, with distance to its three fixed generating vertices; historical priority remains provisional, and no independent audit was performed.
title: The closest-generator distance law of a Reuleaux triangle
